newsitem.title: USA: Graphic Industries to trade on NYSE.
newsitem.headline: Graphic Industries to trade on NYSE.

text.p: Graphic Industries Inc said on Thursday its stock will begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) on June 24 under the symbol "GII."

Graphic Industries, based in Atlanta, currently trades on the Nasdaq National Market under the symbol "GRPH." The company has approximately 11.7 million shares outstanding with a market capitalization of approximately $142 million.
Graphics is a full service printing and graphic communications company.
